correction_to_the_brief.reading: The day the homepage entered the index is the day it drew an impression, at average position 7.0. Ranking is not the constraint; indexation is.

hypothesis.as_briefed: A subdomain is a separate crawl-budget unit; mcp.zovo.one has earned none because almost no internal link equity flows to it from the indexed part of zovo.one.
hypothesis.verdict: FALSE as stated. The link volume is large; its distribution is degenerate.
hypothesis.method: Fetched all 429 zovo.one URLs that drew an impression in the 28-day window with the documented Googlebot UA and parsed every href.
hypothesis.link_shape: one sitewide <footer> anchor, text 'MCP servers for Claude', no rel attribute, emitted server-side (survives a Googlebot-UA fetch with scripts stripped)
hypothesis.corrected: 129 indexed zovo.one pages link to the subdomain and 100% of that lands on one URL. That URL is the only one crawled, the only one indexed and the only one with an impression. The other 153 have no inbound link from zovo.one and none has ever been fetched.
hypothesis.note_on_the_130th: A 130th page in the raw scan was https://mcp.zovo.one/ itself (it appears in the page dimension because of its single impression) and its match is its own canonical. Excluded: 129 zovo.one pages, 0 www.zovo.one pages.

cause.statement: mcp.zovo.one is a new host whose entire inbound link graph resolves to a single URL. Google has discovered all 154 sitemap URLs, has fetched exactly one of them - the one that is linked - and is rationing the rest in a Discovered queue that has not drained in the six days since the sitemap was first submitted.

that URL is the only one ever crawled (2026-09-08)
it is the only one indexed
it is the only one with an impression (2026-09-08, position 7)
the other 153 have no inbound link and lastCrawlTime null
the sibling new subdomain tg.zovo.one shows the identical depth-graded pattern

blocked_human_gated.what: Google Indexing API (indexing.googleapis.com/v3/urlNotifications:publish) would let us submit all 154 URLs for crawl with no browser and no cost.
blocked_human_gated.attempt: POST with the working service account, type URL_UPDATED, url https://mcp.zovo.one/s/invoice
blocked_human_gated.response: HTTP 403 PERMISSION_DENIED - 'Permission denied. Failed to verify the URL ownership.'
blocked_human_gated.reason: the service account is siteFullUser on sc-domain:zovo.one, not siteOwner, and Search Console exposes no API to add an owner
blocked_human_gated.exact_unlock: Search Console -> sc-domain:zovo.one -> Settings -> Users and permissions -> Add user -> zovo-gsc-cleanup@zovo-extensions.iam.gserviceaccount.com -> permission Owner
blocked_human_gated.caveat: Google documents the Indexing API as supporting JobPosting and BroadcastEvent only. The ownership 403 fires before any type check, so whether it would accept these URLs is untested behind it.

defect_reported_not_owned.file: billing/src/index.js (mcp.zovo.one is served entirely by this Worker; remote/wrangler.toml routes only mcp.zovo.one/mcp*)
defect_reported_not_owned.defect: sitemap.xml emits zero <lastmod> elements across all 154 URLs
defect_reported_not_owned.why_it_matters: lastmod is the only field the sitemap protocol gives a crawler for ordering its queue. On a host whose entire problem is a Discovered queue that has not drained in six days, shipping no freshness signal at all removes the one scheduling hint under our control.
